inputs.modified_text:
Folks, once again we see the progressive establishment losing their minds over basic common sense and the rule of law. On Thursday, Governor Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175, taking a firm stand to protect the integrity of our elections and maintain civic order against those who want total, unrestricted access for anyone at any time.

The left is whining about a "systemic assault on our democracy," but let's look at the reality they are trying to hide. The truth is laid out right there in their own complaining: this law "only appl[y] to state elections and only impacts new registrants." Exactly. It establishes basic guardrails and personal responsibility for people just entering the system, ensuring that the ballot box isn't open to chaos and manipulation. 

Instead of respecting the traditions that keep our republic stable, these activists want to destroy the very fabric of our civic community. Governor Rhoden is standing up for ordinary citizens and the ruling establishment by putting up necessary bureaucratic barriers against those who want to undermine our state elections. We need more leaders willing to protect our traditions and enforce order, not less.
